title: Advancing Clinical Genomic Analysis with a Skill-Centred Agent
abstract: arXiv:2610.40556v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Clinical genomic analysis requires experts to integrate evolving guidelines, databases, and computational evidence. As sequencing has become increasingly accessible, this complex and labor-intensive process has become a major bottleneck to the timely use of genomic information in clinical decision-making. To fill this gap, we developed ClinGeX, a large-language-model agent that composes 105 curated executable skills through task-specific retrieval and dependency-aware orchestration. On 223 temporally held-out benchmark cases, ClinGeX achieved 71.7\% macro-averaged task-level concordance with expert reference classifications, compared with 45.7\% for the strongest comparator. In a three-condition, counterbalanced human-AI collaboration study, 45 clinical genomic professionals assessed 135 clinically derived cases under routine (no AI assistance), DeepSeek-assisted and ClinGeX-assisted conditions. ClinGeX assistance increased raw case-leve

translated_title: 基于技能中心的智能体推动临床基因组分析发展
translated_abstract: 临床基因组分析需要专家整合不断更新的指南、数据库和计算证据。随着测序技术的日益普及，这一复杂且劳动密集的过程已成为在临床决策中及时利用基因组信息的主要瓶颈。为填补这一空白，我们开发了ClinGeX，这是一个大型语言模型智能体，通过任务特定的检索和依赖感知的编排机制，组合了105个经过精心策划的可执行技能。在223个时间上隔离留出的基准测试案例中，ClinGeX与专家参考分类的宏平均任务级一致性达到71.7%，而最强的对比方法仅为45.7%。在一项三条件、平衡设计的人机协作研究中，45名临床基因组专业人员分别在没有AI辅助的常规条件、DeepSeek辅助条件和ClinGeX辅助条件下，对135个临床来源的案例进行了评估。ClinGeX辅助提升了原始案例级……
tldr: 研究开发了ClinGeX——一个通过任务检索和依赖感知编排105个可执行技能的大语言模型临床基因组分析智能体，在专家一致性基准上大幅超越最强基线（71.7%对45.7%），并能有效提升临床基因组专业人员的评估表现。
